facts: The principal north-facing gable, lower annex and exterior lantern assembly are shown in the federal measured plates. The east-west survey span is 61 feet 1 inch and the original drawn tower shaft width is 11 feet 10 inches.
Square brick tower, added height in 1896, exterior white coating, attached keeper dwelling. First light in 1873.
Square white tower at Presque Isle State Park. The original focal apparatus was a fourth-order Fresnel lens.
Light-station construction is documented in historic lighthouse plans. The 1962 measured HABS sheets provide the modeled exterior.
